name: tuxnest-vscode
description: TuxNest Chat & TuxNest SI Agent: Use local Ollama and SSH-tunneled Ollama models for AI-assisted coding in VS Code.

commands.title: TuxNest: Connect to Remote GPU Host
TuxNest: Fix Selected Code or Diagnostics

tuxnest.chatMemory.enabled.description: Retrieve relevant older user/assistant messages locally using lexical BM25 ranking. Raw tool results are excluded.

tuxnest.chatMemory.scope.description: Current chat is private by default. All explicitly allows retrieval from other chats in this workspace. Retrieved evidence may be sent to the selected model endpoint.

tuxnest.chatMemory.recentCharacters.description: Character budget for up to ten recent user/assistant messages, separate from older-chat retrieval.

tuxnest.chatMemory.retrievedCharacters.description: Maximum older-chat excerpt characters. Model input budget can reduce this further.

tuxnest.chatMemory.resultCount.description: Maximum retrieved older-chat messages. Use /search chat <query> and /context to inspect sources.

tuxnest.agent.maxRounds.description: Maximum model/tool rounds per task. 0 continues until completion or cancellation, with repeated-action protection. Local model context and memory are still finite.

tuxnest.agent.contextTokens.description: Estimated token budget for automatically retrieved project context. Increase only when your model and hardware support it.

tuxnest.agent.historyCharacters.description: Conversation character budget before old tool results are compacted. This is not an exact model token or context-window measurement.

tuxnest.context.maxIndexedFiles.description: Maximum eligible text files retained in the local workspace index. The index status reports partial coverage when a file, character, or discovery limit is reached.

tuxnest.context.maxFileBytes.description: Maximum bytes per indexed text file. Binary/generated/ignored/sensitive files remain excluded.

tuxnest.context.maxIndexCharacters.description: Total retained source-text character limit for local workspace retrieval. Higher limits use more memory; chunk strings and metadata also consume memory.

tuxnest.ollama.contextWindow.description: Ollama num_ctx for local chat. Larger context needs more RAM/VRAM and must be supported by the selected model.

tuxnest.ollama.maxOutputTokens.description: Ollama num_predict. -1 leaves generation uncapped by this extension; finite model context and hardware still apply. Cancel stops generation.

tuxnest.ollama.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the local Ollama server.

tuxnest.ollama.autoStart.description: Start an already installed local Ollama server when TuxNest opens or models refresh. Uses supported absolute installation paths, never downloads software/models, never starts remote services and never runs workspace commands.

tuxnest.ollama.temperature.description: Local generation sampling temperature. A low value makes coding/tool use less variable; model accuracy is not guaranteed.

tuxnest.ollama.agentThinking.description: Request internal reasoning from thinking-capable models. Off requests non-thinking mode only when the runtime advertises that control; thinking-only models may still reason. For faster CPU tool execution, select a non-thinking Instruct model. Reasoning is not displayed as chat.

tuxnest.providers.openAICompatibleUrls.description: Comma- or newline-separated HTTP(S) API base URLs. Each endpoint has independent discovery/routing. No credentials, query parameters or fragments. Remote endpoints receive selected model prompts/context. Applies after an active task finishes.

tuxnest.autocomplete.enabled.description: Enable local-model inline code completions. Prompts include nearby editor text.

tuxnest.routing.chatModel.description: Preferred model id or provider id for chat. Leave blank to use the selected model.

tuxnest.routing.editModel.description: Preferred model id or provider id for edit proposals.

tuxnest.routing.agentModel.description: Preferred model id or provider id for agent tasks.

tuxnest.routing.completionModel.description: Preferred model id or provider id for inline completions.

scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run bundle
